camel_example: aliyun iot QueryStudioAppList --region cn-hangzhou --FuzzyName test1 --Types.1 'example-string' --PageSize 2 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProjectId a12300000000 --PageNo 1
description_en: You can invoke this API to obtain the application list

kebab_example: aliyun iot query-studio-app-list --project-id a12300000000 --page-no 1 --page-size 2 --fuzzy-name test1 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --types example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryStudioAppList

parameters.description_en:
Project ID.  
1. You can log on to the [IoT Application Development Console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y), select the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.  
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click the project card, and check the address bar of your browser.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。

parameters.description_en:
Application name.  
- Supports Chinese characters, English letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and English parentheses ().  
- Must start with a Chinese character, English letter, or digit.  
- The length cannot exceed 30 characters (one Chinese character counts as one character).
parameters.description_zh:
应用名称。
- 支持中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和英文圆括号（()）。
- 必须以中文、英文字母或数字开头。
- 长度不超过30个字符（一个中文算一个字符）。

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID.  

<props="china">You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must pass this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>  

<props="china">  
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
